_comment: Hand-authored TSDoc overlay for the script-binding API surface (the Script* runtime bindings, the registerScript/PolyglotScript lifecycle object, and ScriptModule) that LiquidBounce's source leaves undocumented. Same mechanism as event-docs-overlay.json: a further apply-kdoc.py pass AFTER the extracted manifest, so genuine upstream KDoc always wins and these only fill gaps (an entry self-retires once LB documents that member). Facts are derived from the Script*.kt / PolyglotScript.kt / ScriptModule.kt source; only members that have NO source KDoc are listed here. No source line refs, so the overlay is version-durable. Schema is the v2 kdoc manifest (tools/kdoc-extractor/manifest.schema.json).

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.script.bindings.doc: Helpers for reading and adjusting the local player's movement (the `MovementUtil` global).
Returns the player's current horizontal movement speed.
Returns whether the player is currently moving horizontally.
Applies strafe movement to the player, steering the current velocity toward the movement-input direction.
Applies strafe movement using the given horizontal speed.

params.speed: the horizontal speed to strafe at

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.script.bindings.doc: Applies strafe movement using the given strength (how strongly the velocity is steered toward the input direction).
Applies strafe movement using both a horizontal speed and a strength.

params.speed: the horizontal speed to strafe at

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.script.bindings.doc: Helpers for sending movement, chat and command packets to the server (the `NetworkUtil` global).
Sends a status-only movement packet (no position/rotation), reporting the on-ground and horizontal-collision state.

params.onGround: whether the player is on the ground
params.horizontalCollision: whether the player is horizontally colliding

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.script.bindings.doc: Sends a position movement packet with the given coordinates.

params.onGround: whether the player is on the ground
params.horizontalCollision: whether the player is horizontally colliding

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.script.bindings.doc: Sends a position-and-rotation movement packet with the given coordinates and look angles.

params.onGround: whether the player is on the ground
params.horizontalCollision: whether the player is horizontally colliding

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.script.bindings.doc: Sends a rotation-only movement packet with the given look angles.

params.onGround: whether the player is on the ground
params.horizontalCollision: whether the player is horizontally colliding

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.script.bindings.doc: Sends a chat message to the server.
Sends a command to the server (without the leading slash).
Helpers for attacking, interacting with and using items on entities and blocks (the `InteractionUtil` global).
Attacks the given entity (no-op if it is the local player).

params.swing: whether to show the arm swing
params.keepSprint: whether to keep sprinting through the attack

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.script.bindings.doc: Interacts with the given entity at the hit result using the given hand (no-op if it is the local player).
Uses (activates) the item held in the given hand.

params.hand: the hand whose item to use

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.script.bindings.doc: Helpers for constructing block positions and reading the world's blocks (the `BlockUtil` global).
Creates a block position from integer coordinates.
Returns the block at the given position.
Returns the block state at the given position, or null if unavailable.
Coerces the argument to a JVM `boolean` (useful when passing a value into Java interop that requires the exact primitive type).
Coerces the argument to a JVM `byte`; a string is parsed (optionally with a radix, default 10).
Coerces the argument to a JVM `short`; a string is parsed (optionally with a radix, default 10).
Coerces the argument to a JVM `char`; a string yields its first character.
Coerces the argument to a JVM `int`; a string is parsed (optionally with a radix, default 10).
Coerces the argument to a JVM `long`; a string is parsed (optionally with a radix, default 10).
Coerces the argument to a JVM `float`; a string is parsed.
Coerces the argument to a JVM `double`; a string is parsed.
Validates and parses command-parameter strings, returning an object with either an accepted value or an error (the `ParameterValidator` global).
Validates the parameter as a string.
Validates the parameter as an existing module name.
Validates and parses the parameter as an integer.
Validates and parses the parameter as a positive integer.
Runs a callback on a new background thread (the `UnsafeThread` global). Unsafe: the callback runs off the client thread, so touching game state directly is not thread-safe.
Runs the callback on a new thread and returns that thread.
Resolves a Java class by its fully-qualified name (accepts `/` or `.` separators).
Constructs a new instance of the class using the declared constructor matching the given arguments.
Resolves a class by name and constructs a new instance using the declared constructor matching the given arguments.
Constructs a new instance of the given object's class using the declared constructor matching the given arguments.

params.obj: an object whose class to instantiate

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.script.bindings.doc: The client's event manager.
The client's configuration system.
The client's module manager.
The client's command manager.
The client's script manager.
The client's combat manager.

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.script.Polyglot.doc: The script's declared name (set from the object passed to `registerScript`).
The script's declared version (set from the object passed to `registerScript`).
The script's declared authors (set from the object passed to `registerScript`).

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.script.bindings.doc: A client module defined by a script - the object passed to a `registerModule` callback. Register event handlers on it with `on(...)`, expose settings, and it participates in the client's module system.
The script that owns this module.
